title: Vintage Charm Meets Modern Style – Sleeps 12+
description:
Stylish 4-story 5 bed/bath Nashville retreat with 6 Queens and 1 King, two living areas, and a covered rooftop with lounge and dining. Just minutes from Broadway, Germantown, and The Nations. Perfect for groups, families, or music-loving friends.

The space
Melody & Manor is a four-story retreat blending modern elegance with musical charm. With six queen beds and one king bed, it comfortably hosts large groups or families. The open-concept living areas feature cozy seating, stylish décor, and plenty of room to gather, while the fully equipped kitchen makes cooking and entertaining effortless.

Step outside to the private deck with lounge and dining area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining under the Nashville sky. Each bedroom is thoughtfully furnished for restful sleep, and bathrooms include modern fixtures and finishes.

4 Stories | 5 bedroom | 7 Beds | 5 Bathrooms

Sleeping arrangements: 6 Queens, 1 King

Two spacious living areas

Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances

Private deck with lounge and dining

Washer & dryer for convenience

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
